Candidate.description:
Bound a proposed memory summary; confidence does not establish factual authority.

约束记忆摘要候选；置信度不建立事实权威。
Candidate.title: Candidate

CatchphraseRule.description:
Optional suitability and repetition limits, never mandatory text insertion.

可选适用场景与重复限制，绝不代表必须插入某个口头禅。
CatchphraseRule.title: CatchphraseRule

CharacterDefinition.description:
Portable stable profile with explicit source facts and revision, not live session state.

包含显式来源事实及版本的稳定可迁移档案，不存放实时会话状态。
CharacterDefinition.title: CharacterDefinition

CharacterState.description:
Retain baseline compatibility state; domain engines own their canonical projections.

保留基线兼容状态；各领域引擎管理对应规范投影。
CharacterState.title: CharacterState

CompanionState.description:
Current life state plus an opaque historical Mood archive.

当前生活状态附带不透明的历史 Mood 档案；未知字段往返保留，不参与当前决策。
CompanionState.title: CompanionState

Decision.description:
Persist a reserved intent and delivery state, not evidence that a message was sent.

保存预留意图及投递状态，不证明消息已经发送。
Decision.title: Decision

DialogueExample.description:
A curated meaning-to-expression example; assistant history is never baseline authority.

精选的语义到人物表达示范；助手历史输出绝不自动成为基线权威。
DialogueExample.title: DialogueExample

EmbodimentProfile.description:
Opt into simulated bodily axes; human physiology is never assumed by default.

显式开启模拟身体维度，不默认假定人类生理需求。
EmbodimentProfile.title: EmbodimentProfile

Evolution.description:
Preserve legacy evolution evidence references separately from approved Growth versions.

保存旧演化的证据引用，与已批准的 Growth 版本分离。
Evolution.title: Evolution

Fact.description:
Describe a sourced character-definition claim, separate from runtime FactRecord.

描述有来源的角色定义声明，与 Runtime FactRecord 分离。
Fact.title: Fact

Goal.description:
Track configured intent and progress; a plan is not evidence of a completed event.

记录配置意图及进度；计划不是已完成事件的证据。
Goal.title: Goal

GrowthPolicy.description:
Bound permitted changes by character domain rather than grant write authority.

按角色领域限制允许变化，不授予写权限。
GrowthPolicy.title: GrowthPolicy

Habit.description:
Track gradual habit support separately from immutable character identity.

记录渐进习惯支持，与不可变角色身份分离。
Habit.title: Habit

LifeState.description:
Track simulated activity timing; simulation must not become shared experience.

记录模拟活动时序；模拟不能变成用户共同经历。
LifeState.title: LifeState

Memory.description:
Store a scoped canonical summary with provenance and validity, never an exact quote.

保存带作用域、来源及有效性的规范摘要，不冒充原话。
Memory.title: Memory

MemoryScope.description:
Explicit memory audience, independent of confidence and retrieval scores.

显式记忆受众；置信度、召回分数和同群关系均不授予访问权。
MemoryScope.title: MemoryScope

Observation.description:
Keep observation, fetch and expiry times distinct with bounded freshness.

区分观察、获取及到期时间，限制新鲜度。
Observation.title: Observation

Relationship.description:
Bound relationship dimensions and explicit interaction boundaries.

约束关系维度及显式互动边界。
Relationship.title: Relationship

Settings.description:
Keep explicit opt-in controls and proactive quiet/rate limits.

保存显式启用开关，以及主动联系的安静时段和频率限制。
Settings.title: Settings

Topic.description:
Keep opted-in follow-up relevance and cooldown state.

保存已允许跟进的话题相关性及冷却状态。
Topic.title: Topic

VoiceProfile.description:
One portable voice model for conversation and professional tasks alike.

闲聊与专业任务共用同一可迁移表达模型，不建立第二套任务人格。
VoiceProfile.title: VoiceProfile

description:
Represent legacy portable character data for validated compatibility imports.

表示旧可迁移角色数据，用于经验证的兼容导入。
title: PackageV2
